Prize pool: 120 USDT

Smallest threshold (parsed): 100 USDT (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Gate ETF Comeback Rewards are live. Earn 10 USDT on your first ETF trade of at least 100 USDT, plus 2 USDT for every 3,000 USDT in cumulative trading volume, up to 5 times. Share an additional 30,000 USDT prize pool, with up to 100 USDT per user. All three rewards can be combined.
Only users who previously traded ETFs and have been inactive for over 7 days at the time of participation are eligible.
Join Now
## Campaign Period: November 16, 2026, 09:30 – November 23, 2026, 09:30 (UTC)
## First-Trade Reward
During the campaign, eligible returning users can claim 10 USDT on their first ETF trade of at least 100 USDT. Limited to the first 1,000 qualifying users, while rewards last.
## Extra Trading Rewards
During the campaign, eligible users earn 2 USDT for every 3,000 USDT in cumulative ETF trading volume, up to 5 times, for a total of 10 USDT. The 10,000 USDT pool is available on a first-come, first-served basis, while rewards last.
## Trading Sprint Rewards
During the campaign, eligible users who meet the cumulative ETF trading volume thresholds can share the corresponding prize pool. Each user qualifies only for the highest tier reached.
Rewards are allocated based on each user’s share of total ETF trading volume in their tier, subject to the tier’s reward cap, with up to 100 USDT per user.
Cumulative ETF Trading Volume | Prize Pool | Reward Cap per User
≥ 10,000 USDT | 3,000 USDT | 10 USDT
≥ 30,000 USDT | 5,000 USDT | 30 USDT
≥ 60,000 USDT | 8,000 USDT | 60 USDT
≥ 100,000 USDT | 14,000 USDT | 100 USDT
## Notes
Participants must click the "Join Now" button on the campaign page to register and complete identity verification to qualify for rewards.
During the campaign, users must select ETF trading pairs to trade. Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume.
First Trade Rewards (ETF Fee Rebate Voucher) and Extra Trading Rewards (USDT) will be issued instantly. Trading Sprint Rewards will be credited to users’ accounts in USDT within 14 business days after the campaign ends.
Batch registration of multiple accounts, malicious wash trading, self-trading, or collusive trading is strictly prohibited. Multiple accounts under the same verified identity will be treated as a single account. Sub-accounts are not eligible.
In case of discrepancies between translated versions and the English version, the English version shall prevail. Gate reserves the final interpretation right of this campaign.
Users from the UK and other restricted regions may be unable to use part or all of the services (including participating in this campaign, games, or competitions). For detailed restricted region information, please refer to the User Agreement.

Exchange/platform: Biconomy.com
Headline: 🏆 ASTER Trading Competition — Share 15,000 ASTER!
Prize pool: 15K ASTER
Start: 2026-11-17T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-23T23:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The ASTER Trading Competition is here!
## Trade ASTER/USDT on Biconomy and compete for a share of the 15,000 ASTER prize pool!
## 📅Activity time
## November 17 — November 23, 2026 (UTC)
## 📝 How to Participate
1. Create or log in to your Biconomy account
2. Register for the campaign: Join Now
3. Trade ASTER_USDT during the event period
⚠️ You MUST register via the form to be eligible.
## 🏁 Competition Rules
## Ranking Calculation
- Ranking is based on total eligible ASTER/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled or unfilled orders are excluded.
- Tie-breaker: If two or more users have the same eligible trading volume, the user who reaches that volume first will rank higher.
## Eligibility
- Minimum cumulative ASTER/USDT trading volume: 500 USDT
- Complete at least 10 filled ASTER/USDT trades during the campaign.
- Registration via form completed
## 🎁 Prize Distribution (15,000 ASTER):
RANKING | PRIZE | Minimum Trading Volume
🥇 1st Place | 2,400 ASTER | 10,000 USDT
🥈 2nd Place | 1,680 ASTER | 8,000 USDT
🥉 3rd Place | 720 ASTER | 6,000 USDT
4th-10th Place | Share 4,200 ASTER by Trading Volume | 3,000 USDT
11th – 30th Place | Share 6,000 ASTER by Trading Volume | 500 USDT
Qualified users will share 15,000 ASTER based on their trading volume rankings.
Your Reward = (Your Eligible Trading Volume ÷ Total Eligible Trading Volume of All Qualified Users in the Same Ranking Group) × Corresponding Prize Pool
## Notes
1. You MUST register via the form to be eligible.
2. Users will be ranked based on their total eligible ASTER/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign period on Biconomy.
3. All rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the campaign ends.
4. Biconomy reserves the right to disqualify accounts involved in wash trading, self-trading, market manipulation, multi-account abuse, or other fraudulent activities. Such trades will not count toward campaign rankings or rewards.
5. Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
